arguments.script: var original=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().path;System.IO.File.WriteAllText("scripts/tilemap-pillars-20261110/restore-scene.txt",original);var test=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.NewScene(UnityEditor.SceneManagement.NewSceneSetup.EmptyScene,UnityEditor.SceneManagement.NewSceneMode.Single);UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(test,"Assets/Editor/PillarTerrainPhysicsTest.unity");int index=0;foreach(var e in UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettings.scenes.Where(e=>e.path=="Assets/Scenes/Level01.unity")){var scene=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(e.path,UnityEditor.SceneManagement.OpenSceneMode.Additive);var root=scene.GetRootGameObjects().Single(g=>g.name=="Unified Terrain Grid");var clone=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(root);clone.name=e.path.Split('/').Last().Replace(".unity","");UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(clone,test);clone.transform.position+=new UnityEngine.Vector3(index*200,0,0);index++;UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.CloseScene(scene,true);}var cameraObject=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Test camera");var camera=cameraObject.AddComponent<UnityEngine.Camera>();cameraObject.tag="MainCamera";camera.orthographic=true;camera.orthographicSize=5;camera.transform.position=new UnityEngine.Vector3(12,-.5f,-20);camera.backgroundColor=new UnityEngine.Color(.15f,.18f,.2f);camera.clearFlags=UnityEngine.CameraClearFlags.SolidColor;UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(test);return "Six whole Grid roots cloned into isolated test scene";
